title: Downgrade from a personal watercraft (PWC) driving licence to a general boat driving licence
summary: Learn how to downgrade from a personal watercraft (PWC) driving licence to a general boat driving licence.
intro:
If you want to downgrade from a personal watercraft (PWC) driving licence to a general boat driving licence, you'll need to surrender your PWC driving licence.

For the general boat driving licence to be issued, your PWC driving licence must be current, or have expired/cancelled less than 5 years ago.
who_can_apply: The PWC driving licence must be current, or have expired/cancelled less than 5 years ago.
what_you_need: A written request stating that the PWC driving licence is no longer required
The Request for Refund Form 1693 (if applicable)

how_to_steps.text: Complete the Request for Refund (Form 1693) – PDF (if applicable).
Return your form and all the required documentation in person or by post.

more_info.text: The duration of a general boat driving licence can be one (1), 3, 5 or 10 years.
Licence fees vary depending on the duration of the licence, and whether they are concessional licences.

If you hold an unrestricted NSW driver licence (all classes) and a NSW general boat driving licence, you may be eligible to combine these 2 licences on one card. Visit Transport for NSW to make sure you have all the information.

faqs.q: What is required to downgrade from a PWC licence?
faqs.a: You must surrender your PWC driving licence to downgrade to a general boat driving licence.

faqs.q: What are the requirements for the PWC licence to be valid for the downgrade?
faqs.a: Your PWC licence must be current, or it must have expired or been cancelled less than 5 years ago.

faqs.q: How do I apply for the general boat driving licence?
faqs.a: Complete the Request for Refund (Form 1693) if applicable, and then return your form and all required documentation in person or by post.
